page.overview:
Who is Gitara Moroso?

Gitara Moroso (pronounced: gih-TAH-rah moh-ROH-soh) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, advisor to Queen Mordrellen Mantear of Andor and the Keeper of the Chronicles under Tamra Ospenya.

She was thought to be beautiful, almost voluptuous, with snow-white hair. She also was flamboyant enough for a Green or a Yellow with a fondness for jewelry.

Moiraine Damodred thought her to be always just and usually fair, but kindness never seemed to occur to her.

Gitara is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .
